description: Compare the latest two stored ChainK9 scans. Returns changed, added and removed module results plus report timestamps. Does not run a new scan or independently verify implementation changes. Requires two saved scans; 404 is not charged. Costs $0.002 per successful call in USDC on Base, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.

chain.description: bsc (BNB Smart Chain, the default), eth (Ethereum) or base (Base)

token.description: Token with at least two stored scans on that chain
